SUCCESSOR AGENCY MINUTES - 09/03/14 - 6 PM
SUCCESSOR AGENCY MINUTES - 09/03/14 - 6 PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
SEPTEMBER 03, 2014
06:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 44
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, DIRECTORS DISPENZA, HOFBAUER, AND THOMPSON
3. CLOSED SESSION - PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
4. PRESENTATION BY GENERAL COUNSEL of the following items to be discussed in Closed Session:
4.1 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the Agency's legal counsel and to receive direction from the Successor Agency regarding the following pending litigation to which the Agency is a party:
BLF Inc., d.b.a. Larrabure Framing v. Westport Construction/Icon Builders, et al.,
Los Angeles County Superior Court Case No. MC 024 618
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54956.9 & 54956.9(a).
Closed session is recommended because the Agency will assess the merits and weaknesses of this matter and consider the Agency's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is the opinion of the General Counsel that it would prejudice the position of the Agency to discuss this matter in public.
5. CLOSED SESSION.
6. ANNOUNCEMENT BY GENERAL COUNSEL of the items discussed in Closed Session.
7. PUBLIC COMMENTS:
8. ADJOURNMENT:

1.
CALL TO ORDER.
Chair Ledford called the meeting to order at 6:01 p.m.
2.
ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, DIRECTORS DISPENZA, HOFBAUER, AND THOMPSON
PRESENT:
Chair Ledford, Director Dispenza, Director Hofbauer, Director Thompson.
ABSENT:
Vice Chair Lackey.
Motion: Excuse the absence of Vice Chair Lackey.
Moved by Director Hofbauer,
seconded by Director Dispenza.
Vote: Motion carried (4-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Lackey, Director Hofbauer, Director Thompson.
Absent: Director Dispenza.
3.
CLOSED SESSION - PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
None.
4.
PRESENTATION BY GENERAL COUNSEL of the following items to be discussed in Closed Session:
General Counsel Ditzhazy stated that all items would be heard as listed.
4.1
The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the Agency's legal counsel and to receive direction from the Successor Agency regarding the following pending litigation to which the Agency is a party:
BLF Inc., d.b.a. Larrabure Framing v. Westport Construction/Icon Builders, et al.,
Los Angeles County Superior Court Case No. MC 024 618
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54956.9 & 54956.9(a).
Closed session is recommended because the Agency will assess the merits and weaknesses of this matter and consider the Agency's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is the opinion of the General Counsel that it would prejudice the position of the Agency to discuss this matter in public.
5.
CLOSED SESSION.
Closed session was held on Item Nos. CC 4.1, CC 4.2, and CC 4.3 from 6:03 p.m. - 7:05 p.m.
Vice Chair Lackey arrived at 6:05 p.m.
6.
ANNOUNCEMENT BY GENERAL COUNSEL of the items discussed in Closed Session.
City Attorney/General Counsel Ditzhazy stated that the Mayor/Chair and all City Councilmembers/Directors were present, and Item CC 4.4 and Item SA 4.1 would be heard after the 7 p.m. meetings
Item 4.1 CC – Norma Sepulveda, et al. v. County of Los Angeles, et al. / Pending Litigation – The City Council was apprised of the status of this matter. No further reportable action at this time.
Item 4.2 CC – Two Claims: Rose Marie Frias as Guardian for Edward Gonzalez (No. 2013-009) and Christopher Gonzalez (No. 2013-010) / Possible Litigation – This matter was not discussed.
Item 4.3 CC – Juan Jauregui v. City of Palmdale (on appeal) / Pending Litigation – The City Council discussed the related appeals and provided unanimous direction to the City Attorney. No further reportable action at this time.
7.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
None.
SECOND CLOSED SESSION was held on Item Nos. CC 4.4 and SA 4.1 from 9:15 p.m. - 10:05 p.m.
ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY/GENERAL COUNSEL of item(s) discussed in Second Closed Session.
Item 4.4 CC - U.S. Department of Justice Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher Program / Possible Litigation - The City Council was provided with an update on the status of this case and provided unanimous direction to the City Attorney. No further reportable action at this time.
Item 4.1 SA – BLF Framing Inc., dba Larrabure Framing v. Westport Construction / Icon Builders, et al. / Pending Litigation - The Successor Agency was provided with an update on the status of this case and provided unanimous direction to the Agency Attorney. No further reportable action at this time.
8.
ADJOURNMENT:
Chair Ledford adjourned the meeting at 10:05 p.m. to October 1, 2014 at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Suite B, Palmdale, California.
PASSED, APPROVED, and ADOPTED this 5th day of November 2014.
_____________________________________
James C. Ledford, Jr., Chair
